summary: Phase 1 backend + frontend tested end-to-end. All 16 pytest cases passed (auth, rigs CRUD, documents + status badges, upload/download via object storage, weigh-station aggregate, drivers create/assign, dashboard, and role enforcement). Frontend UI verified on 390x844 mobile viewport for owner login, driver login, wrong PIN error, rig create, document create with ACTIVE badge, Weigh Station full-screen mode (DOT# populated, aggregate banner correctly shows CHECK PAPERWORK when MC/Insurance/IFTA missing), driver has no Drivers nav tab, and driver Documents page is read-only (no upload button). No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Demo driver is seeded with a hardcoded PIN 1234 and no email - fine for Phase 1 demo but should be gated in production.
Returns 200 on create; conventionally 201 for POST create. Non-blocking.

issues: Floating WEIGH STATION button sits directly above the Docs/Drivers bottom-nav tabs at ~y=692 while nav is at y=764. Bounding boxes do not overlap, but visually the pill is close and could feel crowded on smaller devices.
React a11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Add DialogDescription for accessibility.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Add Rig / Add Document modals to silence a11y warning.
Optional: return 201 status on POST /api/rigs, /api/documents, /api/drivers for REST correctness.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes sync `requests` calls (put_object/get_object) inside async FastAPI upload/download handlers - this blocks the event loop under load. Consider httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_executor.

GET /api/documents currently returns ALL documents for any authenticated user (including drivers). Phase 1 spec allows drivers read-only access, but there is no per-rig scoping - fine if intentional, worth confirming.
GET /api/weigh-station for owner picks the first rig via db.rigs.find_one({}) without a selection mechanism - once multiple rigs exist, owner cannot choose which rig is 'active' for weigh station.
doc_status() treats a missing expiration_date as 'active' - documents with no expiration will never show EXPIRING/EXPIRED even if they should.
Password/PIN uses bcrypt - good. JWT expiry is 30 days (long but acceptable for mobile app).
seed() is not idempotent on PIN change: if ADMIN_PIN env changes it will not update existing owner. Non-blocking for this iteration.
seed_data_creation: Test rig 'UI TEST Rig' and document 'DOT UI Test' (#9876543, exp 2027-03-26, ACTIVE) were created in the DB via the UI and left in place so the owner can see prefilled Weigh Station data. Pytest test data was cleaned up in-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 16 tests, JUnit output at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). All Phase 1 features verified: auth (owner/driver/wrong PIN), rigs CRUD + role gate, documents CRUD + badge computation (active/expiring/expired), object-storage upload+download, weigh-station aggregation, driver create+assign, dashboard next_step, and role enforcement (403 for driver on /api/drivers and POST /api/rigs and POST /api/documents). Phase 2/3/4 features are not built and were not tested.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Two minor a11y warnings and small design polish items only.
